changelog: Phase 41 — Stocktake / физическая инвентаризация. (1) Миграция sql/stocktake-migration.sql: 2 новые таблицы — stocktake_sessions (id, name, status ENUM open/closed/cancelled, started_at/by, closed_at/by, notes) + stocktake_items (session_id FK CASCADE, ingredient_id FK CASCADE, expected_qty snapshot, counted_qty NULL, counted_at/by; UNIQUE(session, ingredient)). (2) Database: getOpenStocktakeSession (с items_total/items_counted aggregates), listStocktakeSessions, getStocktakeSession, getStocktakeItems, startStocktakeSession (refuses if open session exists; snapshots все active ingredients в один SQL), updateStocktakeItem (rejected if session closed), closeStocktakeSession (для каждого item с counted_qty != expected → adjustIngredientStock с delta + reason='stocktake', items без counted_qty skipped; возвращает applied/skipped/total_delta), cancelStocktakeSession. (3) Новая страница /admin/stocktake.php (role admin/owner, gated за inventory feature): если open session — yellow banner + items table с counted-inputs + live variance + кнопки «Закрыть и применить» / «Отменить»; если нет — list past sessions + кнопка «+ Начать инвентаризацию» (modal). Variance highlight: green positive, red negative, gray zero. Auto-save on blur (counted input → POST count action). (4) Новый endpoint api/save-stocktake.php (4 actions: start/count/close/cancel; count доступен employee+, start/close/cancel — admin/owner; CSRF + AuditLog на start/close/cancel — не на count, т.к. слишком noisy). (5) Nav link «Инвент.» в account-header.php. (6) Никаких inline-стилей / inline-скриптов: css/admin-stocktake.css + js/admin-stocktake.js.
